notes: Index change of a Last Minute Change of +100 kg in a main-deck loading zone. A -100 kg LMC takes the opposite sign.
Zones F and G both print -0.2: that is not a transcription slip, it is the printed table rounding -0.243 and -0.153 to one decimal.

The printed table is a rounded presentation of positions.json indexPerKg (x100). It is a controller aid, never a calculation input - compute the exact index change from indexPerKg and only use this table to cross-check.
Below the value row the plate carries two blank worksheet rows (Weight (kg) / Index change). Those are form fields, not data, and are deliberately not modelled.
